view.en: Side-view 2D arena: two wooden platforms you can stand on above the ground, with pillars at both edges. You control an adventurer with a sword and a bow, and the mouse moves a crosshair; your health, flight and mana bars are at the top left, the boss's name, health bar and phase at the top right

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose if your health reaches zero; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate on its own; only hearts sometimes dropped by defeated minions or boss segments restore it

mouse.en: The bow fires toward the crosshair; the crosshair starts at the centre of the arena

keys.en: move left (speeds up to a sprint)
move right (speeds up to a sprint)
jump, higher the longer you hold it; holding it in the air flies for a short time, and once flight runs out holding it glides
drop down through the wooden platform you stand on
use the current weapon (sword or bow)
use the current weapon (same as J)
switch the current weapon between sword and bow
shoot the bow at the crosshair directly

notes.en: Flight refills when you land and lasts about 1.5 seconds
The bow fires about every 0.33 s and the sword swings about every 0.38 s; holding the attack key repeats automatically
The sword sweeps an arc in the direction you face and can hit several targets at once; arrows fly toward the crosshair and stop at the first target. Both can destroy the boss's projectiles
You are briefly invulnerable after being hit; attacking or flying gives no invulnerability
The easy, normal and hard tiers all use classic rules; moves tagged [expert mode only] appear only at difficulty 0.75 or above

summary.en: A giant gel creature keeps leaping to crush you, sheds small gel blobs when hit, and sometimes vanishes and reappears near you.

tell.en: Watch the direction and arc of its jump

effect.en: It lands on you with its body; touching it hurts

counter.en: Step aside from the landing spot and attack while it pauses after landing

tell.en: The third of every four jumps is lower and faster sideways

effect.en: It rushes in low and fast; touching it hurts

counter.en: Jump over it, or fly briefly and let it pass underneath

tell.en: The fourth of every four jumps goes very high

effect.en: It comes down from high up over a wide area

counter.en: Run along the ground away from where it is heading

tell.en: Its body fades out over about a second, then reappears over half a second, usually not far from you

effect.en: Once it reappears it can hit you again

counter.en: Keep moving once it starts fading, then attack after it reappears

phases.en: It shrinks and jumps more often as it loses health, and spawns small gel blobs when damaged

summary.en: A huge floating eyeball that summons small eyes and then charges at you repeatedly; after losing half its health it transforms and charges harder.

tell.en: It hovers, then charges at you three times; each charge keeps its direction once it starts

counter.en: Move sideways once it commits, then attack as it slows at the end of the charge

tell.en: It spins in place and its pupil turns into a mouth (in expert mode it also summons extra small eyes)

effect.en: Afterwards it enters its second form and charges faster

counter.en: You can hit it while it transforms; watch the small eyes still around

tell.en: In its second form it adds faster rushes after the three normal charges, almost nonstop at low health

counter.en: Keep changing direction; never stand still

phases.en: In the first form it summons small eyes that ram you; it transforms into the second form at about half health

summary.en: A giant skull with two independent hands: the hands slam and sweep, and the skull periodically spins after you.

tell.en: Each hand rises and slams down, or lines up with you and sweeps sideways

counter.en: Destroy the hands first; the skull becomes weaker and spins slower

tell.en: After hovering for a while it roars, then spins after you for several seconds

effect.en: The spinning skull hurts on contact

counter.en: Its defence drops while spinning; dodge and hit it

tell.en: Once the skull is hurt enough or a hand is destroyed, it fires skulls that home in on you; not while spinning

counter.en: Change direction to shake them off

summary.en: A long worm made of dozens of segments that tunnels through the ground and platforms after you; breaking a middle segment splits it in two.

tell.en: It speeds toward you while inside the ground or a platform and falls under gravity when it leaves them; there is no extra warning

effect.en: Both head and body hurt on contact; the head hurts most

counter.en: Avoid the head and attack the body as it passes

tell.en: When a middle segment is destroyed the worm breaks into two, each growing a new head and tail

counter.en: Focus heads and tails, or use the sword to hit several segments at once

tell.en: Segments that can see you spit projectiles at you; the tail does not

counter.en: Any attack destroys a spit in one hit

phases.en: You win when every segment is gone; dying segments sometimes drop hearts

summary.en: A giant bee that charges back and forth horizontally, summons small bees, or fires stingers from above you.

tell.en: It flies to your left or right at your height, then charges horizontally back and forth three times; it always opens with this

counter.en: Once you see the height it lines up at, jump or switch platform level, then hit it from behind after it passes

tell.en: It hovers above you and releases a swarm of small bees

effect.en: The small bees chase you and hurt on contact

counter.en: The small bees are fragile, so clear them with arrows or the sword; she is an easy target while hovering

tell.en: She drifts left and right above you, firing yellow stingers

effect.en: Stingers hurt on hit and may poison you

counter.en: Move sideways out of the spread and attack while she repositions

summary.en: A translucent brain ringed by guardian eyes; only after you clear the eyes does it expose its heart and take damage, and then it teleports after you.

tell.en: About 20 guardian eyes circle the translucent brain and take turns lunging at you; the brain cannot be hurt meanwhile

counter.en: Clear the eyes first: they are fragile, the sword can hit several at once, and the one lunging at you is easiest to hit

tell.en: At first it drifts closer, flickers and teleports to another spot near you; once its heart is exposed it fades in and out often and chases you closely

counter.en: It cannot touch you until it has fully faded in; spot the new position and turn to attack at once

tell.en: In the second phase three mirror-image decoys appear around you, more convincing as its health drops

effect.en: The decoys deal no damage; they only confuse you

counter.en: Only the real brain flashes when hit; the decoys mirror around you, so follow the real one's movement

phases.en: In the first phase the guardian eyes protect the brain from damage; once they are cleared the second phase begins and the exposed brain can be hurt
